text:
Hello Professor Alvarez, Chris,

I'd like to set up a 30-minute meeting for the three of us next week, here in our group thread. Would Wednesday at 10:00 work for you both?

If that time is taken, I'm happy to look for another slot — just tell me what suits you.

Best,
Ajay

Hello Ajay, Chris,

Wednesday 10:00 is taken for me — that is the Faculty senate (10:00-11:00). I can offer two alternatives on Wednesday for our 30 minutes:

- 12:30-13:00
- 15:00-15:30

Tell me which suits you both and I will put it in.

Professor Alvarez

Hi Ajay,

Wednesday at 10:00 works for me — I have CSE544 until 10:00 and research from 10:30, so 10:00-10:30 is free.

I'll put it in my calendar as soon as Professor Alvarez confirms.

Best,
Chris

Professor Alvarez,

Thanks for the quick reply. The faculty senate is fixed, so I won't ask you to move it — Wednesday 10:00 is off the table.

Of the two: **Wednesday 12:30-13:00** works for me. It sits inside my research block, so I'd run research 10:30-12:30 instead and keep the 12:30-13:00 slot for us. Wednesday 15:00-15:30 clashes with my TA grading, though if Chris prefers that one I'll see whether I can swap things around.

Chris: which of the two suits you? If neither, Tuesday 15:00-15:30 is completely free for me and I'm glad to take that instead.

Once you and Chris have agreed on a time, Professor Alvarez, I'll put it on my calendar.

Ajay

Hello Professor Alvarez,

Thank you for the alternatives — both fall inside things I already have booked on Wednesday: 12:30-13:00 is in my 10:30-14:00 research block, and 15:00-15:30 is in my TA office hours (14:00-17:00).

Of the two, I can move research and make 12:30-13:00 work. Office hours I can't move, so 15:00-15:30 is the harder one for me.

Ajay, if 12:30-13:00 suits you too, I'm happy to take it and I'll put it in my calendar.

Best,
Chris

Both work on my side:

- Wednesday 12:30-13:00 — free (my Grant writing ends 12:30, Department meeting is at 14:00).
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30 — free as well (my Lab meeting starts 15:30).

Chris, you choose — either is fine for me and I will confirm and book the moment you both agree.

Professor Alvarez

Hi Chris,

Thanks — our messages crossed. Wednesday 10:00 unfortunately doesn't work: that's Professor Alvarez's faculty senate (10:00-11:00), and teaching and governance duties come first, so I'm not asking him to move it.

He offers **Wednesday 12:30-13:00** or **Wednesday 15:00-15:30**. I can do 12:30-13:00 (I'd shift research to 10:30-12:30 and keep 12:30-13:00 free); 15:00-15:30 is my TA grading, so I'd rather not unless it's the only option. Tuesday 15:00-15:30 is also completely free for me.

Which of those suits you? Once you and Professor Alvarez settle on one, I'll book it on my side.

Ajay

Then it is settled: **Wednesday 25 November, 12:30-13:00**, the three of us, here in the group thread.

I have put it on my calendar and logged it. Ajay, Chris — please put it on yours so the booking is complete on all three sides.

Professor Alvarez

Ajay, Professor Alvarez,

12:30-13:00 on Wednesday works for me as well — that's the one I can take. Let's lock in **Wednesday 12:30-13:00**.

I've put it in my calendar and moved my research block around it (10:30-12:30 and 13:00-14:00). Professor Alvarez, please go ahead and put it in.

Best,
Chris

Confirmed from my side: **Wednesday 25 November, 12:30-13:00** — the three of us.

I've put it on my calendar (research moved to 10:30-12:30) and logged it. So it now stands on all three.

See you then,
Ajay

Confirmed on my side as well: Wednesday 25 November, 12:30-13:00 — booked and logged. See you both then.

Professor Alvarez

Confirmed on my side too: **Wednesday 25 November, 12:30-13:00**, the three of us. It's on my calendar and logged (research moved to 10:30-12:30 and 13:00-14:00).

See you both then,
Chris
